versions.changelog: Require shared backup-skill revisions to be published, registry-verified, and applied from one exact ClawHub release.
Adopt one six-hour systemd runner as the sole backup Git owner; replace default health monitoring with a rate-limited OnFailure notifier; prohibit agent-runtime Git pushes.
Use real scheduled backups and notify on actual failure; remove simulated push guidance; exclude generated session transcripts.
Add deterministic 6-hour backup runner policy, separate health monitoring, explicit credential contract, and quieter dirty-file alert semantics.
Initial Daniel agent backup and restore workflow
